title: Тропические каскады
palette: Bright jade jungle, saturated turquoise water, dark warm volcanic tuff, orange hibiscus accents and reddish palm trunks. No cream village.
terrain: Tall staggered tropical terraces arranged diagonally on a deep irregular island mass, broad vegetated ramps joining shelves, two opaque water ribbons descending as finite tiered waterfalls.
landmarks: Two tiered waterfalls, one thick supported stone bridge over a channel, an off-center low thatched hut, chunky palm crowns and a quiet fern clearing. Keep the road dry and unobscured.
road: Wide dark basalt pavers through jade grass, ochre timber bridge deck, low fern shoulders.
journey: Thread through palms, bend inward behind a short waterfall arch with obvious rock clearance, cross the broad supported bridge, sweep through the fern clearing, then curve down a gentle terrace ramp. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Lush broad tropical forms, saturated foliage and sculptural water ribbons with clear solid edges.
architecture: Upgrade EASTERN thatched hut into radio depot with bamboo/ochre walls, brass vents and one chunky dish. Add two palm-roof mountain courier homes into NORTHWEST terrace and an open-sided timber pump workshop on SOUTHWEST shelf. A short wooden windmill with brass hub on eastern rear shelf if room. Keep all waterfall and bridge clearance open.
